subjects.name: American History
subjects.description: History centered on the United States, its peoples, institutions, and global role.

subjects.name: World History
subjects.description: History centered outside the United States or across multiple regions, empires, or global systems.

subjects.name: History
subjects.description: Historical works not better classified under American History, World History, or War & Military.

subjects.name: Biography
subjects.description: Life stories written about another person or group of people.

subjects.name: Memoir & Autobiography
subjects.description: First-person life writing, personal history, and autobiographical nonfiction.

subjects.name: Politics & Government
subjects.description: Politics, elections, public policy, statecraft, diplomacy, and government institutions.

subjects.name: Society & Culture
subjects.description: Social life, cultural change, communities, institutions, and contemporary public debates.

subjects.name: Journalism & Reportage
subjects.description: Reported nonfiction, investigative work, contemporary events, and narrative journalism.

subjects.name: Science
subjects.description: Natural sciences, mathematics, physical and life sciences, and scientific discovery.

subjects.name: Medicine & Public Health
subjects.description: Medicine, disease, health systems, public health, psychology, mental health, and the body.

subjects.name: Nature & Environment
subjects.description: Natural history, animals, ecology, climate, conservation, and environmental change.

subjects.name: Technology
subjects.description: Technology, computing, engineering, infrastructure, and their social effects.

subjects.name: Business & Economics
subjects.description: Business, labor, finance, markets, economic history, and capitalism.

subjects.name: Arts & Criticism
subjects.description: Art, music, film, performance, literary criticism, and cultural criticism.

subjects.name: Religion
subjects.description: Religion, spirituality, theology, religious history, and belief.

subjects.name: War & Military
subjects.description: War, military institutions, battles, soldiers, and armed conflict.

subjects.name: Race & Ethnicity
subjects.description: Race, ethnicity, civil rights, migration, indigeneity, diaspora, and racial inequality.

subjects.name: Gender & Sexuality
subjects.description: Gender, sexuality, feminism, LGBTQ life, reproductive politics, and gendered experience.

subjects.name: Travel & Place
subjects.description: Travel writing, place-based narrative, geography, landscapes, and local exploration.

subjects.name: Sports
subjects.description: Sports, athletes, sporting cultures, and athletic institutions.

subjects.name: True Crime & Justice
subjects.description: Crime, courts, policing, prisons, legal systems, and miscarriages of justice.
